rationale: Jawad brings deep fintech and AI domain expertise from his time at Citi and Tudor, plus recent focus on vertical AI-SaaS through Collaborative Intelligence, while Rory is building AI-assisted productivity tools with strong engineering discipline after scaling Discord's platform. intro_message: Jawad Koradia, meet Rory Hughes — you're both London founders navigating AI product-market fit from different angles, and Jawad's fintech + AI expertise and mentoring experience could be valuable as Rory scales Highlight's vision for proactive, production-ready AI.
